limitations: Each accessor executes in isolation through the original context dispatch and SPI callbacks; only the SPI transfer helper and memcpy are supplied, with authored receive bytes and statuses.
Names follow the ST lsm6dso_reg.c accessor each body matches by register and bit field; the ODR setters here write only the raw ODR field (no ST-style power-mode bookkeeping).

Getters with a failed read store a stale stack byte; those paths are not exercised. Which accessors the hub calls, in which order and with which values is a separate question (the activate/configure callbacks); nothing here drives a real LSM6DSO.
